design_philosophy: High-end concierge service. Less Uber Eats, more private member's club. Emphasize negative space, cinematic dark mode, and elegant typography.

tab_bar.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10 pb-6 pt-4 px-6 flex justify-between items-center

service_card.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl group border border-white/5 bg-[#141414]
service_card.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent

promo_banner.classes: relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-[#111111] border border-[#A3B18A]/30 min-h-[160px] flex items-center p-6

ai_button.classes: rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#A3B18A]/20 to-transparent border border-[#A3B18A]/50 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-3 text-[#A3B18A] flex items-center gap-2

search_bar.classes: w-full bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-4 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#A3B18A] transition-colors

layout_strategies.home_screen: Top: Elegant Search Bar + Filter. Next: Wide cinematic Promo Banner. Next: Horizontal scroll for Service Categories (Tall cards, not square blocks). Next: 'Curated For You' Vertical list of Restaurant/Service Cards.
layout_strategies.restaurant_detail: Hero: Massive full-width image (40vh) fading into black. Content: Overlapping the hero slightly with a glassmorphism header holding the restaurant title and rating. Menu: Distinct typography, minimal borders, elegant price tags.
layout_strategies.general: Never use pure white blocks or default shadcn cards. The entire app should feel like a nighttime drive in a luxury car. Use `pb-32` on main containers to account for the floating tab bar.

motion.hover_effects: Subtle scale (scale-105) on images, opacity fade on text.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade-in. Use Framer Motion for a staggered entrance of list items.

parcel_category.description: Luxury black car at night for parcel delivery

ai_feature_bg.description: Abstract dark green glow for AI mood feature button or banner

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css.
Build a mobile-first web app mimicking a premium iOS application layout.
Use Lucide icons but keep them thin (stroke-width 1.5) to match luxury feel.
Ensure the bottom navigation is fixed, glassmorphic (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70), and elegant. Hide scrollbars to keep it clean.
Use Playfair Display for all main headings (H1, H2, Cards Titles) and Manrope for body text.
Never use typical massive shadow boxes. Rely on 1px subtle white/10 borders and high contrast backgrounds.
All cards must have absolute positioning gradient overlays to ensure text over images is 100% readable.
Inject framer-motion staggered animations on the Home screen to make the loading feel like a bespoke experience.
Avoid standard Shadcn 'Card' wrapper styles. Build custom raw HTML/Tailwind divs to ensure edge-to-edge cinematic imagery.
testing_attributes_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='service-food-tab').
